project: Wuxia Life P12 Wuxia World Profile Formalization
description: Formalize wuxia as a complete executable WorldProfile by inventorying the current scattered wuxia-owned runtime surfaces, defining a strict WorldProfile schema, moving stats/resources/identity tracks/action families/summary signals into profile-owned structure, making narrative and selected gameplay-facing readers profile-first, reorganizing config ownership around WUXIA_WORLD_PROFILE, and proving completeness through a dedicated P12 profile gate plus closure regression evidence without introducing a second theme, UI changes, or save-schema changes.

userStories.title: Inventory current wuxia-owned runtime surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of current wuxia-owned runtime surfaces so that P12 starts from exact migration targets instead of assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current wuxia-specific definitions for stats, resources, identity tracks, action families, summary signals, and narrative config entrypoints
For each category, record the current source files and whether the source is already profile-like or still scattered
Record which runtime readers currently bypass WUXIA_WORLD_PROFILE
Save the inventory under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay logic in this story

userStories.title: Define formal WorldProfile type skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a formal WorldProfile type skeleton so that wuxia has a clear executable profile contract instead of a loose narrative wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: Define top-level profile fields for stats, resources, identityTracks, actionFamilies, summarySignals, stageConfig, routeDefinitions, echoHooks, and summaryTemplates
Each top-level field uses explicit runtime-oriented types rather than Record<string, unknown> placeholders
The type definition makes required-versus-optional sections explicit
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Document playable-profile requirements in schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the schema to encode which sections are required for a playable profile so that later stories can validate completeness consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: The schema or adjacent code comments document which profile sections are required for a playable world profile
The schema distinguishes executable required fields from optional descriptive metadata
Missing required sections can be detected by later verification code without ad hoc rules
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define wuxia stats metadata inside the profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want wuxia player stats represented inside the world profile so that stat meaning is no longer implied only by core state structures.
acceptanceCriteria: Define wuxia stat entries inside the profile for currently player-facing and scheduling-relevant stats
Each stat entry declares id, label, and role or usage category
The profile shape can be consumed without changing existing save data shape
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define wuxia resources metadata inside the profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want wuxia spendable or accumulable resources represented inside the world profile so that resource structure stops living in scattered gameplay assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define wuxia resource entries inside the profile for currently used resource-like values such as money, energy, connections, or project-native equivalents
Each resource entry declares id, label, and usage role
The profile shape can be consumed without changing existing save data shape
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define wuxia identity tracks inside the profile
userStories.description: As a designer, I want wuxia identity tracks declared inside the profile so that route identity becomes first-class world-pack data.
acceptanceCriteria: Define profile identity tracks for martial, scholar, social, wealth, wanderer, deviant, cautious, and balanced paths or their project-native equivalents
Each identity track links to relevant route ids or identity signals
Existing route identity resolution remains compatible with the declared tracks
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define wuxia action-family metadata inside the profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want active action families declared inside the profile so that action-direction structure becomes part of the theme definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Define profile action family entries for the current wuxia action directions used in the 0-40 slice
Each action family links to the current action catalog or action ids through explicit profile metadata
The profile shape can be read without introducing a duplicate authoritative action map
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define wuxia summary-signal metadata inside the profile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want summary signal structure declared inside the profile so that summary assembly depends on theme config instead of scattered knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Define profile summary signals for route identity, origin, echo-derived summary parts, and other currently used age-40 summary inputs
Each summary signal declares slot, variable or source role, and intended use in summary assembly
Existing configured summary output remains functionally compatible
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Attach stage, route, echo, and summary config to the formal profile

acceptanceCriteria: WUXIA_WORLD_PROFILE satisfies the formal profile schema for stageConfig, routeDefinitions, echoHooks, and summaryTemplates
Existing narrative config sections are attached through the profile instead of a parallel wrapper
No second authoritative narrative config source is introduced

userStories.description: As a developer, I want one profile-first runtime entrypoint for narrative config so that stage, route, echo, and summary reads stop defaulting to scattered single-file access.
acceptanceCriteria: NarrativeConfigLoader or equivalent runtime entrypoint reads stage, route, echo, and summary structures from WUXIA_WORLD_PROFILE

No duplicate authoritative config source is introduced
